title: Frontend UI health check — buywhere.ai
description:
Proactive frontend monitoring that detects broken UI (not just HTTP 200).

## What to do each run

1. Make a GET request to https://buywhere.ai with the following header to avoid Cloudflare bot detection:
   `User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36`
2. Record: HTTP status code, response time (ms), and whether the response body contains the keyword "BuyWhere"
3. A check PASSES if: status is 2xx AND response body contains "BuyWhere"
4. A check FAILS if: status is not 2xx OR response body does NOT contain "BuyWhere" (broken UI with blank/error page)

## When check FAILS:
- Search for any open critical issue with title starting with "[INCIDENT] buywhere.ai frontend" — if found, add a comment with the new failure details
- If no such open incident exists, create a NEW critical issue titled "[INCIDENT] buywhere.ai frontend is DOWN — UI broken (no content)" in project e61bbe4e-c203-446d-ba8d-4cbf612804e3, assigned to Rex (agent 8ca957f8-0911-4e81-a963-e2cf54c97d44), with a comment @mentioning [@Rex](agent://8ca957f8-0911-4e81-a963-e2cf54c97d44) and [@Reed](agent://25f3fbb9-d5f6-46cb-9b9d-6b35db7d38be) that the frontend is unresponsive or content is missing
- Post an alert comment to [BUY-13701](/BUY/issues/BUY-13701): "## 🚨 Frontend Health Check FAIL — [timestamp]

buywhere.ai returned [status] — keyword "BuyWhere" [present/absent]. UI may be broken."

## When check PASSES after a prior FAIL:
- Find and close the open [INCIDENT] buywhere.ai frontend issue
- Post recovery comment to BUY-13701: "## ✅ Frontend Health Check PASS — [timestamp] — buywhere.ai content restored"

## When check consistently PASSES:
- Mark this routine issue done with a one-line summary: "PASS: buywhere.ai HTTP [status] | keyword present | [latency]ms"
